inventory.description: Definitely real tickets. Probably box seats. Trust him.
inventory.flavor_text: The seats are real. The 'exclusive experience' is just sitting.

inventory.description: Standing room, probably. Or maybe seats. Who knows?
A tiny cup of coffee for a not-tiny price.
inventory.flavor_text: It's very good. It's also very small.

inventory.description: The same espresso, but you're facing the opera house.
inventory.flavor_text: The view is technically free. The supplement is... mandatory.

inventory.description: Sinfonia's famous chocolate cake. Gustav loved it.
inventory.flavor_text: Layers of chocolate and apricot. Worth the price. Almost.

inventory.note: Not Gustav. Gustav doesn't do photos anymore.

discoverable_items.description: Coins tossed by tourists making wishes. They belong to... Neptune? Probably Neptune.
discoverable_items.flavor_text: Someone wished for love. You got €2. Fair trade.

discoverable_items.description: An unusually old coin from the fountain. Might actually be lucky.
discoverable_items.flavor_text: Dated 1887. Someone's wish from over a century ago. You're inheriting their luck.

discoverable_items.description: Coins left at the Beethoven shrine by reverent tourists.
discoverable_items.flavor_text: Beethoven probably doesn't need money. But neither do you, so fair game.

discoverable_items.description: Sheet music for a Mozart piece. Won from the street performer challenge.
discoverable_items.flavor_text: You can't read it, but holding it makes you feel sophisticated.

quest_items.description: Half-empty bottle of Austrian schnapps. Evidence of Hans-Jürgen's... condition.
A worn photograph of Gustav from Hans-Jürgen's pocket. Happier times.
quest_items.flavor_text: Gustav looks... younger. Less done with everything.

quest_items.description: Bradley's loose Skittles. Apparently horses love them.
quest_items.flavor_text: Taste the rainbow. Convince the horse.

quest_items.description: An opera cape Gustav acquired during his escape. He's keeping it.
quest_items.flavor_text: Gustav refuses to give it back. It's his now.

quest_items.description: An itemized list of everything destroyed during the Gustav chase.
quest_items.flavor_text: You can pay this. Eventually. Maybe.

achievement_items.description: Awarded for successfully convincing Gustav to return to work.
A desperate attempt to replace Gustav. It did not work.
achievement_items.flavor_text: Bradley was the back half. He doesn't want to talk about it.

achievement_items.description: The harness Bradley wore during the failed replacement attempt.

lore_items.title: Beethoven Shrine Dedication
lore_items.content: Dedicated to Ludwig van Beethoven, who walked these streets composing symphonies in his head. He was deaf. He was a genius. He would hate the tourists.
